Type-1 Zoning Map Amendment
For 932 N Elston Ave., Chicago, IL 60622

From M3-3 to B2-3

1. A. The applicant seeks a zoning change from M3-3 zoning district to a B2-3 Zoning
District to meet the bulk and density standards of the B2-3 Zoning District to
allow the construction of a new Four Story Single Family Residence with an
attached |-car garage. The proposed building height is 41 feet. The applicant will
also seek the following Variations:

a) Per Section 17-13-1003-I, a reduction to the required rear yard setback from
30 feet require to 11’-0”.

b) Per Section 17-13-1003-J, to allow the required open space to be located on a
deck or patio located more than 4 feet above ground.

Applicant will seek all zoning relief as needed for the attached plans,
according to the Chicago Zoning Code.
